query.text: 出行助手，请在我询问路况或停车问题时，及时回答我。
query.text_en: Travel Assistant, please answer me promptly when I ask about road conditions or parking issues.

annotation.text_zh: 抱歉，我无法看到车外，无法帮您判断。
annotation.text_en: Sorry, I can't see outside the car, so I can't help you judge.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
